notes.title: 2.2.2 Update: Balance update and Convenience enhancements
notes.content:
[h2]Balance update[/h2]
Story mode has become more difficult.
[list]
[*] Increases enemy's vision
[*] Increases the HP of enemies and bosses in Story Mode
[*] Nerf repeater skill cooldown
[*] Decrease the knockback rate for the arrow
[/list]

[h2]Convenience enhancements[/h2]
Players feedback has been reflected.
[list]
[*] Windowed mode window support
[*] V-SYNC support (optional)
[*] Sound volume control support
[/list]
